stormwater.caveat: P_E = 1.0 in is the Manual's floor; Table 5.3 sets it by % impervious and HSG (SSURGO: B/D, C, D). Infiltration feasibility depends on the Sec. 32-131 soils investigation. Concept approval from DPIE precedes preliminary plan.

result.whyNotTheCap: One public street with one entrance serves a 5.3-ac triangle 414 ft deep at most. The 2023 sheet reached 19 lots with a loop street (two entrances) and an 18-ft private alley serving the interior; with one entrance and no alley the interior is reached only from the inside of the L, so the inside-corner and outside-corner lots run deep (12–17k sf) and 14 conforming 9,500-sf / 75-ft lots is the most of 285 searched geometries. All 14 front the proposed street; none take access from Wheeler Road.
